# Blitz3D

Commands for the 3D world. They need a 3D graphics mode (`Graphics3D`).

Back to [Home](Home) or the [Command Index](Command-Index).

* [3D Sound](Blitz3D-3D-Sound) (2): Sound listeners and sounds emitted from entities.
* [Animation](Blitz3D-Animation) (16): Bone, vertex and MD2 animation.
* [BSP](Blitz3D-BSP) (4): Quake 3 BSP levels.
* [Brushes](Blitz3D-Brushes) (12): Reusable material settings applied to meshes, surfaces and entities.
* [Cameras](Blitz3D-Cameras) (13): Camera range, viewport, fog and projection.
* [Collisions](Blitz3D-Collisions) (19): Collision types, responses and results.
* [Display](Blitz3D-Display) (9): Opening 3D modes and querying driver capabilities.
* [Entities](Blitz3D-Entities) (43): Creating, moving, scaling and querying entities.
* [Lights](Blitz3D-Lights) (5): Light types, color, range and cone angles.
* [Meshes](Blitz3D-Meshes) (23): Creating, loading, transforming and querying meshes.
* [Picking](Blitz3D-Picking) (15): Finding what lies under a point, line or camera position.
* [Sprites](Blitz3D-Sprites) (7): Camera-facing sprites.
* [Surfaces](Blitz3D-Surfaces) (29): Vertices, triangles and surfaces of a mesh.
* [Terrain](Blitz3D-Terrain) (10): Height-map terrains.
* [Textures](Blitz3D-Textures) (51): Creating, loading, transforming and filtering textures.
* [Transforms](Blitz3D-Transforms) (13): Converting points, vectors and normals between entity spaces.
* [World](Blitz3D-World) (18): Rendering, updating and clearing the 3D world.
